safety_tips.tip: Keep fuel above half a tank in forest and ghat sections
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Pratheek_Karnataka_All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: Avoid late-night driving on ghat roads and in elephant corridor zones
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Pratheek_Karnataka_All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: Roads in the Western Ghats may get slippery during sudden rain; drive cautiously
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Pratheek_Karnataka_All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: Do not leave valuables visible inside the car during sightseeing stops
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Pratheek_Karnataka_All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: Carry physical ID copies (Aadhar/passport) for hotels and temple entries
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Pratheek_Karnataka_All Inclusive Guide.docx

connectivity_tips.tip: Network can be patchy in forest belts; download offline Google Maps in advance
connectivity_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Pratheek_Karnataka_All Inclusive Guide.docx

health_tips.tip: Carry mosquito repellent, especially for Sakrebyle and riverside stays
health_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Pratheek_Karnataka_All Inclusive Guide.docx

health_tips.tip: Carry personal medicines, basic pain relief and motion sickness tablets for winding hill roads
health_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Pratheek_Karnataka_All Inclusive Guide.docx

health_tips.tip: Use sunscreen SPF 30+ and a cap or hat for sun exposure during drives and outdoor visits
health_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Pratheek_Karnataka_All Inclusive Guide.docx

health_tips.tip: Carry wet wipes and hand sanitiser for frequent roadside stops
health_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Pratheek_Karnataka_All Inclusive Guide.docx
